_comment: omni.kit.converter.hoops_core 512.2.1 options per conversion profile (names as in the extension's HoopsOptions / docs/SKILL.md). Chosen by scripts/convert_step_to_usd.ps1 -Profile; per-asset profile and LOD in config/cad_assets.json. Why these values: docs/decisions/2026-10-23 STP to USD 변환 강화.md

legacy._comment: Day 5-6 settings (base = user's usd_converter). Extra-low tessellation: curved faces became coarse polygons.

machine._comment: Line equipment seen from a distance: medium tessellation, colours as materials, STEP product names as metadata.

product._comment: Products seen close up by the inspection camera: higher tessellation so curved surfaces and silhouettes are smooth. convertPhysicsData was tried and authored nothing for these STEP files (see docs).
